reports.title: Reports queue
reports.subtitle: Incidents your users flagged as problematic (spam, harassment, false info…). Review them here and choose whether to dismiss the report or remove the incident. You can also ban the reporter or the author from any row.

hints.open: Fresh reports from users, waiting for your review.
hints.dismissed: Reports you marked as "no action" — filed for the record.
hints.actioned: Reports whose incident you removed — the user who flagged it got heard.
hints.all: Every report in the system, newest first.

reportRow.removePromptTitle: Reason for removing this incident (shown only in the audit log):

banDialog.title: Ban user
banDialog.body: Banning {user} immediately prevents them from posting, voting or reporting. Reads are not affected. You can revert this from the Bans tab.
banDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Repeated false reports after warnings.
banDialog.reasonError: Please describe why you are banning this user (3+ chars).

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.subtitle: The full catalogue, including hidden incidents. Search or filter to find one, then remove it (hides from the map), restore a previously hidden one, or ban its author. Unlike the Reports tab, you act here without waiting for a user flag.

hints.all: Every incident ever created, regardless of state.
hints.pending: Just reported by a user, waiting for community votes.
hints.validated: Confirmed by enough upvotes — currently visible on the map.
hints.dismissed: Hidden from the map. Either a moderator removed it or the community voted it down. Use "Restore" to bring it back.
hints.resolved: Marked by the community as no longer a problem on the trail.
hints.expired: Automatically retired after its expiry date. Hidden from the map.

incidentRow.removePromptTitle: Reason for removing this incident (audit log):

bans.title: Active bans
bans.subtitle: Users currently banned from interacting with the platform. They cannot create incidents, vote or report anything. Reading the map still works so they understand why their actions fail. Expired bans disappear from this list automatically; use "Unban" to lift an active one early.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.subtitle: A chronological audit trail of every moderation action taken on the platform — who did what, on which target, and why. Entries here are append-only: they cannot be edited or deleted, which makes this the canonical record if you ever need to review past decisions.

linkedAccounts.title: Linked accounts
linkedAccounts.description: Connect multiple sign-in methods to a single account so you can log in with any of them without ending up with duplicate profiles.
linkedAccounts.cannotUnlinkLast: You cannot unlink your only sign-in method
linkedAccounts.lastProviderNotice: Link another method before unlinking your only current way to sign in.

dangerZone.confirmBody: This permanently removes your profile, incidents, votes and uploaded photos. It cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm.

settings.cooldownHint: When several incidents land close together, you'll only get one notification — the most severe.
